verification_method: Read-only inspection of the current public API manual's React content bundle referenced by the live API page. No authenticated API calls or production writes were made.

general-notes.findings: UTF-8; ISO8601 timestamps; four decimal places with rounding up; URL-encoded JSON for PUT/POST; query parameters URL-encoded; meta/data envelope and potentially empty DELETE body.

auth.findings: Authentication may be provided in an Authorization header or Authorization query parameter. Validation is not implemented by this simulator.

get-inventories.findings: GET /inventories; no body; item_type/status/category_id/color_id include/exclude filters; returns list of inventory summaries.

get-inventory.findings: GET /inventories/{inventory_id}; integer ID; no body; inventory resource.

create-inventory.findings: POST inventory resource; method table includes trailing slash, example omits it; returns created inventory. Lists more writable fields than the simulator supports.

update-inventory.findings: PUT inventory by integer ID; signed quantity delta rather than absolute replacement; editable price/description/remarks and additional unsupported inventory fields. color_id is absent from the writable list.

delete-inventory.findings: DELETE inventory by integer ID; no body; empty data on success. Exact choice of empty envelope versus empty HTTP body is not specified here.

get-orders.findings: GET /orders; direction defaults in; filed defaults false; status supports inclusion/exclusion; returns summary fields, not full detail. Summary spells grandtotal differently from resource schema.

get-order.findings: GET order by integer route parameter; no body; full order resource.

get-order-items.findings: GET order items; array of arrays with one inner array per order batch.

resource-representations-inventory.findings: Inventory field types, condition and stockroom values, fixed-point price, and is_retain sold-out meaning. Requiredness, defaults, null handling, and zero-quantity write effects are not fully specified. Example categoryID conflicts with schema category_id.

resource-representations-order.findings: Order and order-item fields; decimal prices and totals; currency/display fields. order_id is a string in the table but integer in its example. categoryID example conflicts with category_id schema; cost.grand_total in resource conflicts with summary grandtotal.

historical_reference.use: Background only; not the verification source for this contract suite. In particular its update color_id listing differs from the current manual.
